jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, NACF
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst, supporting operational and functional leaders. Amazon operates the most complex retail networks in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses annually. Come be part of this tremendous organization and join a dedicated team committed to operational and financial excellence where you will focus on the inputs, think like an owner and where every day is Day One.

The NACFinance team vision is to provide cost controllership, projects return on investment (ROI), and financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across supply chain. Our team supports various North America teams through translating operational KPIs into financial impact to ensure our stakeholders have the most up to date and reliable information to make the best possible decision for Amazon. The ability to learn and be curious while working through a high degree of complex ambiguity in order to think big while inventing and simplifying for process improvement is mission critical.

Key job responsibilities

Key Business Support

End-to-end ownership of the financial planning cycles which include forecast modeling, bridging, network partnership and presentations to senior leadership.
Perform projects financial validations to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights.
Collect, analyze and manage quantitative data and create meaningful reports to lead business improvement and defect cost reduction strategy.
Perform root cause analysis to uncover core issues using data, then assisting the operation stakeholders to improve and create new measures for sites productivity.
Invent and simply processes to drive efficiency and cost improvement over finance processes related to defect costs.
Thinking big to deliver scalable solutions to better understand end-to-end cost and identify new improvement opportunities.

Controllership

Intuitively utilize active listening skills to communicate data (both written and verbal) in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner, adjusting your style based on audience, to articulate complex finance issues.
Create effective business partnership with senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and provide guidance for cost strategy and goals.
Have backbone and challenge business partner plans and assumptions when needed.

Team Leadership

Take part in developing and mentoring activities, and leverage diverse perspectives.

A day in the life

The Defect Cost Controllership (DCC) team focuses on finance controllership, cost savings and end-to-end (e2e) defect cost reduction across North America Customer Fulfillment (NACF). The primary time spend is focused on workstreams to identify opportunities that lead to cost reduction, process improvement, and financial controllership. The team is also responsible for project financial validations, return-on-investment, and tracking financial impact on budget baselines. The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, developing and leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables

About The Team

The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment, and collaborates with Customer Service, Transportation and Delivery teams for an end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. The endless opportunity to invent on behalf of our customers ensures the work is always fun.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

jobs.description:
About Us

Grow was born to tackle a critical challenge: making mental health care more effective and accessible for everyone. Since launching in 2020, 15 million sessions have started on Grow, and we've barely scratched the surface. We do it through a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Every solution we build reveals ten more waiting to be delivered, and that's just what gets us going. We've backed that ambition with more than $328M in funding, including our Series D at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

At Grow, the work you do can literally change someone's life. Your work here doesn't stay on a screen; it impacts whether someone can find, afford, and access quality care. That ambition sets us apart, and offers you an endless runway to impact one of the world's most urgent issues. We don’t have passenger seats here. Everyone is driving something that matters.

This work deserves real commitment. So if you thrive on meeting problems head on, untangling serious complexity, and working at pace with the sharpest yet kindest people around, you've come to the right place.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Sr. Data Analyst to help us drive data-driven insights and reporting in Product at Grow Therapy, and who will work on a variety of reporting, analytics and experimentation projects. You’ll join a broader data organization of analysts, data scientists, and data engineers, and be part of an Analytics team reporting into an Analytics Manager. This role will support our Lives Covered product group, focused on Billing & Payments features.

What You’ll Be Doing

Partner with Product and other technical stakeholders to prioritize analytical needs and support product launches, decision-making, and ad hoc requests through clear, data-driven insights.
Develop, maintain, and evolve core product and performance reporting, including business-critical dashboards built on scalable, reliable datasets.
Support experimentation and A/B testing through thoughtful design, execution, analysis, and clear, actionable conclusions.
Create compelling data visualizations and storytelling assets to effectively communicate insights to diverse audiences.
Collaborate with stakeholders on complex, high-impact analytical projects, including data modeling and OKR development.
Work closely with data scientists and data engineers to improve data availability, integrity, accuracy, reliability, and logging/pipeline quality.
Identify business-critical opportunities to improve claims collection and reduce billing friction.

You’ll Be a Good Fit If

You have 5+ years proven experience in using analytics to tackle business problems that cross multiple product/project areas and teams, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
You have strong SQL skills and intermediate understanding of experimental design (such as A/B experiments).
You are a wizard at building business critical dashboards/data visualizations (ideally within Hex).
You have experience with data modeling (dbt) or are eager to learn.
You love data storytelling, creating a compelling narrative by extracting insights from data, and summarizing learnings / takeaways for executives.
You have prior experience analyzing healthcare data, particularly across the claims lifecycle and patient billing processes.
You enjoy communicating effectively and building relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You deeply value the importance of expanding access to mental health care.

Full Time Employee Benefits

Health Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
Grow for Grow: No cost access to therapy through the Grow platform (available to US employees)
Financial Wellness: Retirement savings programs and equity opportunities to help you invest in your future.
Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays & Winter Break: Flexible time off, company paid holidays (which vary by country), and a full company wide Winter Break to rest and recharge
Parental Leave: Up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave to support you and your growing family and a new child stipend.
Mental Health Mornings/Afternoons: Dedicated weekly flexible time for self care, whether that's therapy, exercise, journaling, time with family, or simply taking a break.
Wellness & Development Stipend: Annual stipend to support your personal wellbeing and professional growth, from fitness and education to books and learning resources.
Commuter Benefits: Pre tax commuter benefits to support teammates working from one of our hub locations.
Home Office & Meals: Support for your home workspace plus meal benefits, with offerings tailored to both remote and hub based employees.
Additional Perks: A variety of wellbeing benefits, including wellness memberships, virtual care, pet insurance discounts (where available), and global travel assistance.

Why ARA at Stryker?

The Assurance & Risk Advisory (ARA) function at Stryker continues to grow as we strengthen our focus on technology-enabled risk management, governance, and assurance. We are seeking a Senior Technology Risk Analyst to play a critical role in helping the organization proactively manage technology risks while supporting Stryker’s strategic objectives. This role offers the opportunity to work with a global, collaborative team that delivers value through innovation, strong partnerships, and customer focus.

As the Senior Technology Risk Analyst, you will be responsible for executing technology-focused internal audit and risk advisory engagements, including SOX compliance testing, system implementation reviews, technology and data risk assessments, and operational audits. This individual serves as a subject matter expert in the auditing of IT general controls (ITGCs), IT automated controls (ITACs), and key reports across ERP platforms and other enterprise applications. The role requires knowledge and experience with internal control frameworks, and audit methodologies, as well as a strong understanding of financial reporting risks and technology-enabled business processes. The Senior Technology Risk Analyst applies internal audit principles and practices aligned with AICPA and PCAOB guidance / standards to assess control design and test operating effectiveness while providing clear concise reporting to key stakeholders within ARA team and broader organization.

What You Will Do

Participate in audit planning by understanding business processes, identifying technology risks, and developing risk-based audit procedures.
Perform process walkthroughs, control evaluations, and testing to assess the design and operating effectiveness of technology controls.
Test IT General Controls (ITGCs), automated controls, and key reports across enterprise applications and technology infrastructure to support SOX 404 compliance.
Support technology advisory and consulting engagements related to system implementations, process changes, and technology initiatives.
Prepare high-quality audit workpapers and documentation in alignment with internal audit methodology, professional standards, and department policies.
Analyze audit evidence, identify control gaps and process improvement opportunities, and clearly document audit observations.
Partner with Management to develop remediation action plans, monitor progress, and validate the resolution of identified control deficiencies.
Review SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports for third-party service providers and assess their impact on the organization’s overall control environment.

What You Need

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, accounting, finance, or a related field
Minimum 2 years of professional experience in public accounting, internal audit, or management consulting
Experience testing ITGCs across enterprise applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments
SAP S/4 audit experience
Experience supporting business process audit teams in the testing of automated controls, key reports, and other IT-dependent controls
Strong understanding of internal audit principles, methodologies, and professional standards

Preferred:

Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or other relevant certifications
MedTech or other regulated-industry experience

Own key trial-level analytics workstreams (e.g., enrollment forecasting, feasibility analysis, protocol input)

Role Summary

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Tag Management & Tracking to join the Customer Profile & Identity team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. You will own the tagging and tracking layer that every marketing measurement decision at McAfee depends on — the tag management system, the data layer, the campaign parameter framework, and the third-party vendor tags and conversion APIs that connect mcafee.com to our advertising, affiliate, and marketing platforms.

This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of marketing, web engineering, and analytics. McAfee’s consumer web experience spans landing pages, cart, and checkout across 40+ locales, instrumented through a tag management system (Tealium iQ and EventStream), an Adobe standard digital Data layer, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, and a growing set of server-side and client-side vendor integrations — Google (Floodlight, Offline Conversion Import), Meta Conversions API, Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat, Amazon, Impact Radius, and more. You will be the person accountable for making sure all of it fires correctly, collects the right data, and stays governed.

You will own tag governance end to end: intake and requirements for new vendor tags, implementation and QA in the tag management system across dev/QA/production environments, validation that business-as-usual tags continue to fire and collect after every website release, and the campaign parameter and tracking specifications that make downstream measurement and attribution possible. When a metric looks wrong, you are the person who traces it from the ad click through the URL parameters, the data layer, the tag management extensions, and the analytics beacon to find where it broke.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Profile & Identity and works in close partnership with Web Engineering, MarTech, Marketing, Data Engineering, Privacy/InfoSec, and external vendor and agency teams.

Location: This is a remote position based in the United States or Canada. We will only consider candidates currently authorized to work in the US or Canada and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.

Position Details

About The Role

Own third-party tag vendor governance and implementation — serving as the single point of accountability for how advertising, affiliate, and marketing vendor tags are requested, reviewed, approved, implemented, versioned, and retired across the consumer web estate
Maintain a governed tag inventory — documenting every active tag, its owner, its business purpose, the pages and locales it fires on, the data it collects, and its consent requirements; proactively identifying and removing tags that no longer serve a purpose
Ensure business-as-usual (BAU) tags are implemented and collecting as required — monitoring tag health continuously, validating collection after every website and template release, and driving rapid resolution when a tag stops firing or starts reporting incorrect values
Own campaign parameter and tracking requirements — defining and governing the URL parameter framework (campaign hierarchy, source and sub-channel codes, promo codes, price, affiliate IDs, ad platform click IDs) so that traffic, conversion, and revenue can be attributed accurately end to end
Translate marketing measurement requirements into technical tracking specifications — partnering with Marketing, Product, and Analytics to turn a campaign or experiment plan into a documented spec covering data layer fields, tag management variables, analytics dimensions and events, and vendor payloads
Ensure the data layer is firing and passing correct data to every tag — owning the digitalData contract between the CMS/content layer and the tag management system, defining required fields and value formats, and working with Web Engineering to fix gaps, timing issues, and value transformation defects
Enable destinations to required systems — configuring and validating the flow of events and audiences from the web collection layer to analytics, CDP, customer engagement, and advertising destinations, including server-side conversion APIs and first-party domain collection
Implement and QA tag management changes across environments — building load rules, extensions, and variable mappings; managing promotion from dev to QA to production; and following release governance including HAR/vendor validation, UAT sign-off, and go-live monitoring
Build and run tracking validation and QA processes — using browser debugging tools, network beacon inspection, and automated validation (headless browser scripting, parameter comparison, pre/post release checks) to confirm tracking integrity at scale rather than by spot-check
Lead root cause analysis on tracking and attribution defects — tracing a discrepancy from the source click through URL parameters, the data layer, tag management logic, and the vendor beacon; quantifying impact; and delivering a documented fix with a regression check
Support website migrations, redesigns, and A/B tests — producing pre/post tracking comparisons, running go/no-go validation on new URL structures and templates, and ensuring experiments are instrumented so results are measurable and trustworthy
Partner with Privacy, Legal, and InfoSec on consent and compliance — ensuring tags respect consent management and cookie banner behavior, that new vendor tags clear privacy review before launch, and that collected data stays within approved boundaries
Govern analytics variable allocation — maintaining a solution design reference for analytics dimensions and events, preventing redundant and duplicate variable use, and freeing capacity for new tracking needs
Manage vendor and agency relationships on the implementation side — running technical onboarding for new tag vendors, resolving integration issues with platform support teams, and holding vendors accountable to documented requirements
Document and communicate clearly — maintaining implementation guides, tracking specifications, release notes, and validation reports that Marketing, Engineering, and Analytics can all rely on as the source of truth

About You

You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in web analytics implementation, tag management, or marketing technology engineering
You have deep hands-on experience with an enterprise tag management system (Tealium iQ, Adobe Experience Platform Tags/Launch, or Google Tag Manager) — building load rules, extensions, variable mappings, and managing versioned promotion across dev/QA/production environments
You are fluent with data layers — you can read and debug a JavaScript data layer object, define what a page must expose, and explain precisely how a value travels from the data layer into a tag payload
You have strong working JavaScript and browser debugging skills — DevTools, network beacon inspection, HAR capture, tag debugger extensions — and can diagnose why a tag is not firing without waiting on an engineer
You have production experience implementing Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (eVars, props, events, AppMeasurement) or an equivalent enterprise analytics platform, including maintaining a solution design reference
You have implemented third-party advertising and affiliate tags and conversion APIs — Google Ads/Floodlight, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat, affiliate networks — and understand click ID capture, deduplication, and conversion payload requirements
You understand campaign tracking and attribution mechanics — UTM and custom parameter frameworks, click ID persistence, channel and sub-channel taxonomy, and how a broken parameter silently corrupts reporting
You are rigorous about validation — you build repeatable QA processes and pre/post release checks rather than relying on manual spot-checks, and you can automate them when volume demands it
You have strong SQL skills and can query event and clickstream data directly to confirm that what you implemented actually landed correctly downstream
You can operate as the governance owner — saying no to an ungoverned tag request, holding a vendor to a documented requirement, and running an intake process that Marketing stakeholders actually respect
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences — writing tracking specifications engineers can build from and explaining measurement impact to marketers in business terms
You have experience working in agile environments with 2-week sprints, managing recurring release-validation work alongside project deliverables, and communicating progress proactively

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Experience Platform, Web SDK, and XDM schema design
Experience with a CDP or event-routing platform (Hightouch, Segment, mParticle) and configuring downstream destinations
